title: Wamor Kwaromo Kod Osiepe
author: With Friends On Earth
stanzas: Wamor kwaromo kod osiepe; E piny ma mwalo ni;
To chunywa kuyo ka waparo; Wabiro pogore.
E pinyni tho opogowa kod; Osiepe mwahero;
Wamor kwageno wananegi, E piny maber manyien.
Kucha ok wanawachi chutho; Wach moro mar pogruok;
To mor gi kuwe nobed e chunywa, Pile ma nyaka chieng.
chorus: Ok wanapogre e polo, Ok wanapogre ngang`;
E piny maberno wanamor, wanapogre ngang`.
